data.title: Bitcoin and ethereum prices today, Wednesday, October 21, 2026: Crypto to outperform stocks and gold?
data.description: Bitcoin opened at $82,940.14 on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, up 1.3% from Tuesday's open. As of 7:21 a.m. ET this morning, the price of bitcoin rose to $83,292.55.
